content.short: Embracing the irony and proving Cardano is no 'Ghostchain' with a series of community-focused projects.
content.description: Embracing the irony and proving Cardano is no 'Ghostchain' with a series of community-focused projects such as a community NFT marketplace called FreeRoam. FreeRoam aims to become a renowned project on Cardano. It aims at allowing a simple exchange of art and other collectibles, as well as helping talented artists bridge the technical gap required to join the CNFT space.
